== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Gryth is an individual encountered on [[Kareia]], a planet within the [[United Worlds]]. He appears to hold a professional role involving investigation or enforcement, as he possesses the ability to perceive contents within a person's pocket and [[void space]]. During an interaction with [[Lindon]], Gryth transitions from a calm and welcoming demeanor to a more stern, professional attitude when questioning the origins of an item. He warns against resistance, noting that his group has previously detained [[Monarchs]] and suggesting that a prior strike was merely a warning. While he attempts to negotiate for survival by suggesting cooperation before Planetary [[Security]] arrives, he also expresses significant fear regarding the presence of a [[Silverlords|Silverlord]], claiming such entities are impossible to combat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Gryth is a man characterized by his gray hair. He possesses a left eye that gleams.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|He has the power to see everything contained within a person's pocket and [[void space]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Gryth is a gray-haired man distinguished by a gleaming left eye. Serving as an officer of Import Processing, he possesses the ability to see everything contained within a person's pocket and [[void space]]. During his encounter with [[Lindon]], he found himself trapped within the man's grip.}}
